scope: Resources for Part C research and modelling only. They assert no booking, visit, meeting or completed audience experience.

resources.title: Assembly of Sea Forms
resources.caption: Barbara Hepworth, Assembly of Sea Forms, 1972, white marble (BH 555). Image and work details: Barbara Hepworth Estate. Collection: Norton Simon Museum, Pasadena.
resources.alt: A group of pale stone forms stands on a dark circular base. Rounded upright and low forms surround a taller central form with a small hole near its top.
resources.pupilPrompt: Point to one shape or space that you want to learn more about. Check the caption for the material. Keep what you can see apart from what the source tells you.
resources.purpose: Makes the existing model's named work visible; pupils can select an actual feature instead of imagining an unspecified approved-pack picture.
resources.verification: Read the stable record and its image source; downloaded and visually inspected the 17,813-byte image. The caption names white marble, 1972, BH 555 and the collection.
resources.rightsNote: The Estate site's navigation states that its images and texts may be reproduced for non-commercial educational use. Preserve attribution and the source link; do not represent the image as an original teaching illustration. Its footer also directs reproduction permission queries to the Estate.
resources.offlineFallback: Use the credited local picture plus caption and alt text in the downloadable teaching pack. The source link remains available for checking; no remote image request is needed while teaching.

resources.title: How Henry Moore Created Sculpture From Nature
resources.pupilPrompt: Choose one natural form Moore used as a starting point. What did he do to turn that idea into a sculpture? Keep a source note with your answer.
resources.purpose: Offers a second genuine artist and a visual process source. Use it when a pupil chooses Moore or when comparing how an artist starts from an observed form.
resources.verification: The Foundation learning page describes this exact film, credits presenter Joey Yu and animator Gemma Green-Hope, and embeds YouTube ID J92qMI2IQbI. Film playback and captions were not independently watched or verified in this lane.
resources.delivery: Optional external link, never autoplay. Staff choose and preview a short relevant passage before class within the existing lesson time. No invented duration or timecode. A pupil choosing Hepworth is not required to switch artists.
resources.offlineFallback: Use the named artist picture and checked source notes already in the pack. The task is researching a making process, so a source passage and an accessible description can serve it when the film is unavailable. Do not download or redistribute the film as part of the ZIP without permission.

factSources.title: Biography
checkedSections: 1921–24: sculpture study at the Royal College of Art
1925: learnt marble carving from Giovanni Ardini
factSources.use: Supports the existing C2 model and the four-question sorting activity. Select art-relevant sections; the full biography includes sensitive life events not required for this task.
